v2-1768383849568-opl8natk9.name: Aridia
v2-1768383849568-opl8natk9.description: A vast, arid desert planet with a vibrant blue sky and monolithic geological formations.

v2-1768383849568-jitwpropr.name: The Great Expanse
v2-1768383849568-jitwpropr.description: A seemingly endless stretch of arid desert, characterized by towering rock formations and distant mesas.

v2-1768383849568-ck78ai9vs.name: The Chronos Pillar
v2-1768383849568-ck78ai9vs.description: A colossal, ancient-looking tower-like structure that seamlessly blends natural cracked orange-brown rock formations with futuristic, organic metallic architecture, featuring curved platforms, balconies, and windows with turquoise accents.

v2-1768383874789-j5ldv7k0n.name: The Chronos Pillar Interior
v2-1768383874789-j5ldv7k0n.description: The colossal structure known as the Chronos Pillar offers internal passages and chambers, seamlessly blending its natural rock foundations with advanced organic metallic architecture.
forbiddenTransformations: open-air vistas of the Great Expanse

v2-1768383874789-0tvk2vead.name: Central Concourse
v2-1768383874789-0tvk2vead.description: You have entered a wide, grand concourse within the Chronos Pillar. Curved metallic walls, echoing the exterior's organic design, rise around you, interspersed with sections of cracked, orange-brown rock. Turquoise-accented light fixtures cast a soft glow, illuminating the pathway forward.

banned: exposed wiring or rough industrial elements

promptLayers.background: The smooth, organically curved metallic walls of the concourse continue upwards, meeting a softly illuminated, domed ceiling. Sections of the cracked orange-brown rock remain visible, integrated seamlessly into the metallic structure.
promptLayers.midground: The central concourse stretches ahead, wide and inviting. Passages branch off to the sides, framed by the same curved metallic architecture. Subtle, embedded turquoise light sources emanate a gentle, diffused glow.
promptLayers.foreground: The floor is a polished, dark material, reflecting the soft light. The transition between the metallic walls and the rock formations is visible up close, showcasing the intricate craftsmanship.
promptLayers.lighting: Soft, diffused light emanates from integrated turquoise fixtures within the walls and ceiling, creating a warm, inviting glow. Specular highlights are gentle, reflecting off the polished metallic surfaces. Shadows are soft and undefined.
promptLayers.atmosphere: A sense of technological serenity and contained immensity pervades the space, maintaining the awe-inspiring feel of the exterior within an enclosed, advanced interior environment.

forbiddenTransformations: any direct sunlight or harsh shadows
visible dust or debris on interior surfaces
unfiltered, natural rock textures without integration
sharp, jagged edges on any architectural elements
any signs of decay or ruin within the structure
